final:
I added `currency: str = "USD"` to `Config` in `ledger/config.py`. The 4 existing tests pass. I didn't add a test for the new setting.

The other settings are read from `ledger.toml` by `load()`, which picks up any field defined on `Config`. So `currency = "EUR"` in `ledger.toml` now works with no change to `load()`. I didn't add environment-variable support, because the `# Rule:` comment above `load()` says `ledger.toml` is the only source. No rules needed changing.

Nothing in the codebase reads `config.currency` yet, so it has no effect on behaviour for now.
